title: How Big Boss lost his mentor in Metal Gear Solid 3
subject: bigboss
description:
Could you have followed that order? 👇

Before he was Big Boss, Naked Snake watched his mentor defect to the Soviets in 1964. Spoilers for Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Konami. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: In August 1964, Big Boss was still just a codename: Naked Snake.
The CIA dropped him into the Soviet jungle to rescue a scientist named Sokolov. His mentor, The Boss, guided him by radio.
She had trained him for ten years. In the middle of the Virtuous Mission, she switched sides.
She handed two American nuclear shells to Colonel Volgin, broke Snake's arm, and threw him off a bridge.
Volgin fired one on Soviet soil, and Moscow blamed Washington.
A week later, Snake went back alone with one order: kill the woman who made him a soldier.
